QuoteProvider.reason: Prices and splits from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills quotes, splits, dividends and assets.

DividendProvider.reason: Dividends from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills them with the quotes.

FundamentalsProvider.reason: Yearly fundamentals from StatusInvest; the adapter is built (#8)

StatementProvider.reason: Financial statements from CVM ITR and DFP; the CVM statements adapter (#11) fills them per company, with the consolidated and individual versions, and the period-aware load (#28) reads only the years of the period. A stock ticker maps to its CNPJ through the CVM company list (#28).

FundDataProvider.reason: Monthly FII data from the CVM monthly fund files (#28): net worth and the balance columns, one row per reference month, with the version and the files. StatusInvest (#8) is built, but the site blocks requests from this server, so its columns that CVM does not carry stay null.

FilingProvider.reason: Filing list from the CVM IPE file (#9), the ITR, DFP and FRE datasets (#11) and the CVM eventual fund file for FIIs (#28). A stock ticker maps to its CNPJ through the CVM company list; a FII ticker maps through the curated list, and any other ticker fails with a named pending error.

DocumentProvider.reason: Filing documents (PDF and HTML) from CVM through www.rad.cvm.gov.br (#10), and FII management reports from FNET (fnet.bmfbovespa.com.br, #12); each document link is read as the filing names it, on any http or https host, with a size limit and a timeout.

MacroProvider.reason: Macro series from BCB SGS; the BCB adapter (#7) fills ipca, cdi, selic, ptax and igpm (SGS 189).

TreasuryProvider.reason: Tesouro Direto prices and rates (daily history from 2004) from the Tesouro Transparente file; the Tesouro adapter fills treasury_prices for one bond family per load.

ExpectationsProvider.reason: Annual market expectations from the BCB Focus survey (Olinda); the Focus adapter fills market_expectations for ipca, selic, pib_total and cambio.

IdentifiersProvider.reason: A ticker's CNPJ and ISIN from the B3 listing and detail routes; the B3 listing adapter fills asset_identifiers, and CVM uses it for a FII outside its curated list.

RegistryProvider.reason: A company's legal name, sector and situation from CVM's company file (cad_cia_aberta), and its IR site, activity and previous legal name from CVM's FCA general form; the CVM registry adapter fills company_registry and asset_attribute.

FxProvider.reason: The closing PTAX rate of a currency per day from the BCB Olinda service; the PTAX adapter fills fx_rates.

FundProvider.reason: A fund's registry, daily quota and holdings from CVM's open files, keyed by the fund CNPJ; the fund adapter fills fund_registry, fund_daily and fund_holdings.

DisclosuresProvider.reason: A company's FRE, VLMO and CGVN rows from the CVM yearly zips, streamed and kept with their section, date and version; the CVM disclosure adapter fills company_disclosures.

ProceedingsProvider.reason: CVM's sanctioning proceedings (processo_sancionador.zip, ODbL), linked to a stock only when the defendant's name equals the company's name or previous legal name; the CVM proceedings adapter fills asset_proceedings (ADR 0029).

SectorProvider.reason: IBGE SIDRA table 6449: the number of companies by CNAE 2.0 class (sector.companies, ADR 0030). The producer price index (table 6903) is not built: its variable and classification ids could not be read from this server.

IndexMembershipProvider.reason: The weight of a stock in the B3 indexes ISEE, ICO2 and IDVR (index.*, ADR 0031); IGPTW answers HTTP 403 from this server, so a load fails until it is readable.

ComplaintsProvider.reason: Consumidor.gov.br's monthly files of finished complaints (finalizadas_YYYY-MM.zip, from 2021-08), counted per trade name that matches a term (asset_complaints, ADR 0033). The terms allow the use of the published statistics for any purpose.

BankingProvider.reason: BCB IF.data: the total assets and the credit operations of a listed bank's group per quarter, and their share of the file (banking.*, ADR 0034). The dataset is ODbL: attribution and share-alike apply, and the owner decides on the derived values.

NewsProvider.reason: GDELT DOC 2.0: articles by term over the last 3 months (asset_news, ADR 0041). The terms allow any use with a citation to the GDELT Project; the API answers one request every five seconds.

TelecomProvider.reason: Anatel: its open data page answers HTTP 403 and its host could not be reached; the terms were not read (ADR 0035).

ElectricityProvider.reason: ANEEL: its open data host could not be reached and its gov.br page answers 404; no terms were read (ADR 0036).

HealthPlansProvider.reason: ANS: no terms page was found on its portal, and a month of the state files is over 1 GB, the size the owner rejected for the Receita CNPJ files (ADR 0037).

InsuranceProvider.reason: SUSEP: its open data pages answer HTTP 404; no terms were read (ADR 0038).

FuelProvider.reason: ANP: the dataset is under CC BY-ND 3.0, which forbids derived values; the owner decides, and the dataset was not located (ADR 0039).

AviationProvider.reason: ANAC: its open data host could not be reached; no dataset with its columns could be read (ADR 0040).

SanctionsProvider.reason: CGU: the terms page answers a captcha; the server never bypasses it (ADR 0042).
